claim_under_pricing: Implementation smoke only: extend the observation-degradation wrapper to road-boundary and obstacle continuous geometry channels, and audit whether left/right split-mu is physically expressible in the current single-track simulator. This admits no training, no driver mutation, and no controller-performance claim.

seed_discipline.selection_training_or_validation_reuse: none: this is an env-contract smoke and expressibility audit, not training, target pricing, selection, or validation

geometry_degradation_profile.obstacle_continuous_indices: canonical obs72 slot continuous indices x/y/rel_vx/rel_vy; present bits and size slots untouched

preregistered_readouts.obs_shape: Raw and degraded frames must keep obs72 shape.
preregistered_readouts.ego_and_command_boundary: Ego-response channels 0-8 and previous-command channels 9-11 must remain bitwise identical when only geometry noise is enabled.
preregistered_readouts.road_degradation: Road-boundary indices 12-43 must show non-zero perturbation under geometry_scope=road_and_obstacle.
preregistered_readouts.obstacle_degradation: The active obstacle slot continuous fields x/y/rel_vx/rel_vy must show non-zero perturbation.
preregistered_readouts.obstacle_slot_contract: Obstacle present bits, active-slot size fields, and empty obstacle slots must remain bitwise identical.
preregistered_readouts.termination_consistency: Raw and degraded paired rollouts must keep identical termination/truncation fields because geometry noise is observation-only.
preregistered_readouts.determinism: Same seed plus same scripted actions must reproduce degraded observations and termination fields bit-for-bit.
preregistered_readouts.split_mu_expressibility: If the current simulator lacks left/right wheel contacts or per-side normal loads, declare split-mu not physically expressible instead of adding a fake dynamics label.

decision_rule: Accept B3 smoke iff all wrapper contract readouts pass on the full seed set and split-mu is either implemented with a physically meaningful mechanism or explicitly declared not expressible in current-sim.
runtime_gates: quick smoke passes before the full smoke
default observation_degradation geometry_scope=none leaves existing ego-degradation tests green
geometry noise uses a disjoint RNG substream from ego noise/dropout/delay
claim_boundary: B3 geometry-degradation implementation smoke and split-mu expressibility audit only; no training, no driver mutation, no validation ranking, no promotion, no driver-performance, no current-sim robustness-result, no high-fidelity sufficiency, no paper, no repair-success, no feasibility-proof, and no self-ID claim.
